_schema._READ_THIS_FIRST: The note categories are NOT all mutually exclusive. Summing them exceeds gold_note_items_examined. That is intended; see below.
_schema.status: Cell-level. CRITICAL_FLIP | DISPLACED | MISREAD | OK partition the 1,240 day-cells per model. Sum == 1240.

notes.partition: NOTE_OK + NOTE_OMISSION == gold_note_items_examined (146). These two, and only these two, partition the gold notes.
notes.overlay: NOTE_DISPLACED is a SUBSET of NOTE_OK, not a sibling of it. A displaced note has correct text (so it is NOTE_OK) attached to the wrong day. Summing OK+OMISSION+DISPLACED double-counts the displaced ones.
notes.note_displacement_rate: NOTE_DISPLACED / gold_note_items_examined. sonnet 1/146 = 0.7%; haiku 9/146 = 6.2%. These are the README's 'Note displacement rate' row.
notes.fabrication: A fabricated note would be text absent from the page. There is no such category here because the count is zero for both models: 0/146 each, Wilson 95% upper 2.6%.

_schema.relationship_to_calendar_level_csv: DIFFERENT UNIT, SAME WORD. The 'displaced' column in calendar_level.csv is the CELL-level status DISPLACED (sonnet 0, haiku 19 of 1,240 cells). The README's 'Note displacement rate' is NOTE-level (this file). They are not the same quantity and will not agree; neither is derivable from the other.
